description: This file defines the Data Access Object (DAO) interface for 'Category' entity in a Room database, including methods for retrieving, inserting, finding by name, and deleting categories.

classes.name: CategoryDao
classes.description: DAO interface for performing database operations on Category entities

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all categories ordered by name case-insensitively.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new category into the database, ignoring conflicts.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Finds a category by its name, returning the category entity or null.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a category by its ID.
